name: NuBlox Developer Handoff Pack

product.governing_security_rule: Career != Organisation Role != Project Role != Permission

authentication_and_tenancy.tenant_authority: active NuBlox user + active organisation_members row
authentication_and_tenancy.selected_organisation_cookie: selection hint only; server revalidates membership
authentication_and_tenancy.signup_policy: fail-closed; exactly one valid invitation or organisation-bootstrap intent
authentication_and_tenancy.foreign_record_policy: tenant-owned foreign public IDs are masked where disclosure would leak tenant identity

permission_model.umbrella_policy: resolve granular key first; same-domain umbrella applies only when granular has no explicit member/role decision; explicit granular deny cannot be bypassed
permission_model.cross_domain_policy: permission umbrellas never cross domain families

Owner.package_004_policy: explicit contract formation/execution/amendment granular grants plus full finance billing/invoice grants

Administrator.package_004_policy: explicit contract formation/execution/amendment granular grants plus full finance billing/invoice grants

standard_roles.bootstrap_parity: existing-tenant forward migration grants and future OrganisationBootstrapService grants are asserted at persisted role-permission-row level; Package 004B amendment granular grants are now persisted for future Owner/Administrator roles

implemented_workflow: Controlled Invoice Issue and Immutable Evidence

non_effects: no contract formation inside conversion transaction

contract_formation.initial_value: fixed-precision sum of non-optional accepted quotation net lines
contract_formation.execution_policy: issued+locked version -> execution/signatory evidence -> version executed + logical contract active; project lifecycle remains independent

contract_amendments.eligibility: same-tenant active logical contract with executed contract-version baseline
issue_invariants: substantive narrative and/or value/date change evidence required
issued amendment immutable through ordinary draft APIs
contract_amendments.value_policy: signed DECIMAL(19,4); positive increases, negative decreases, zero rejected; no JavaScript binary floating point for authoritative arithmetic
contract_amendments.current_value_formula: executed baseline value components + sum(agreed amendment value adjustments)

accounts_receivable_invoices.creation_policy: finance.invoice.create OR finance.manage AND contract.view; source contract must be same-tenant active with executed baseline and client party
accounts_receivable_invoices.numbering_policy: first tenant-local issue format INV-000001 etc.; number allocated only inside issue transaction; database unique document key is final uniqueness guard
accounts_receivable_invoices.line_policy: quantity DECIMAL(19,6) > 0 and unit rate DECIMAL(19,4) >= 0; fixed-precision scaled BigInt arithmetic
accounts_receivable_invoices.tax_policy: draft tax is provisional; effective tenant tax-category rate is resolved and applied again at actual issue time before immutable issue
accounts_receivable_invoices.billing_policy: payment terms derive due date at issue; customer PO/reference is mandatory at issue where party billing settings require it
accounts_receivable_invoices.snapshot_policy: issue snapshots customer, optional billing contact and billing-address evidence
accounts_receivable_invoices.immutability_policy: issued invoice rejects ordinary draft header/line mutation
context_controls: current contract value = executed baseline + agreed amendments
previously issued contract net = net of other issued invoices for same contract

validation.status: first executable Package 004C head validated; final documentation-synchronised PR head must prove the same gate before merge

next_boundary.name: Receivable Corrections and Cash Application
recommended_sequence: controlled invoice void/reversal and credit-note policy
next_boundary.governing_rule: issued financial documents are immutable facts; corrections and cash application create controlled new records rather than editing history
